_comment: THE SWITCH for the seasonal deal on the homepage (#black-friday) and in the JustFlip app (Today card, paywall labels). "show": "off" | "blackFriday" | "cyberMonday" (the theme of one entry below). Change it, commit, push: the website follows within a minute, the app at its next launch or return to the foreground (at most every 10 minutes). No dates: nothing turns on or off by itself. Missing or unknown value = off. The prices are set separately in App Store Connect (Lifetime price schedule; subscriptions as introductory offers, see ios/Tools/Offers/subscription-sale.py in the app repo). The app labels a plan only while the store price backs it (Lifetime at most maxPriceVsYearly x Yearly; a subscription when the customer is offered a paid introductory price), so switching on before the price drops shows nothing in the app, but the website trusts this file. plans: the discounted plans, the first is preselected on the paywall. id: a new id shows the Today card again to people who closed the previous one.
